head: 9f5d8492

workload.tls: QUIC v1, TLS 1.3, pinned P-256 CertificateVerify

conclusion: The current in-process handshake harness measures 81.01 allocations and 383,574 bytes per connection. The two largest per-connection allocations are one >64-KiB allocation (~230,096 bytes) and one <=64-KiB allocation (65,536 bytes). The historical ~57-allocations/connection figure came from a different harness and is not reproduced here; this is a baseline for future pre-trust allocation work, not a regression claim.
